sections.title: Present Subjunctive Mood
sections.content:
Present Subjunctive का प्रयोग suggestion, demand, recommendation, order के बाद that-clause में होता है। इसमें verb का base form आता है, चाहे subject singular हो या plural।

Structure: Subject + suggest/recommend/insist + that + subject + base verb

4-5 चरण समाधान विधि:
Step 1: Main verb पहचानें (suggest, demand, recommend, insist)।
Step 2: That-clause देखें।
Step 3: Subject singular हो तब भी verb का base form रखें।
Step 4: -s, -es या past form न लगाएं।
Step 5: Meaning check करें — यह सुझाव या आदेश हो।

Example:
I suggest that he go early. (Not: goes)
They demanded that she be present.

sections.title: Past Subjunctive (Unreal Situations)
sections.content:
Past Subjunctive मुख्यतः hypothetical या unreal condition में 'were' के रूप में आता है।

Structure: If + subject + were

4-5 चरण समाधान विधि:
Step 1: देखें क्या स्थिति काल्पनिक है।
Step 2: If clause पहचानें।
Step 3: I/he/she/it के साथ भी 'were' लगाएं।
Step 4: Main clause में would/could/might लगाएं।
Step 5: Reality से तुलना करें।

Example:
If I were the manager, I would change the rules.

sections.title: It is High Time / About Time
sections.content:
It is high time / It is about time के बाद Simple Past आता है, लेकिन अर्थ present या future से जुड़ा होता है।

Structure: It is high time + subject + past verb

4-5 चरण समाधान विधि:
Step 1: Phrase पहचानें (high time/about time)।
Step 2: उसके बाद subject देखें।
Step 3: Verb को Simple Past में बदलें।
Step 4: Meaning check करें — देरी हो चुकी है।
Step 5: Present tense न लगाएं।

Example:
It is high time we started our work. (Not: start)

sections.title: Inverted Structures (Hardly/No sooner/Scarcely)
sections.content:
Negative adverb से वाक्य शुरू हो तो auxiliary पहले आता है (inversion)।

Structure:
Hardly had + subject + V3 when...
No sooner had + subject + V3 than...

4-5 चरण समाधान विधि:
Step 1: Sentence की शुरुआत में hardly/no sooner/scarcely देखें।
Step 2: Auxiliary verb subject से पहले रखें।
Step 3: Past Perfect (had + V3) लगाएं।
Step 4: जब-तब संबंध (when/than) सही चुनें।
Step 5: दूसरा clause Simple Past में रखें।

Example:
Hardly had I reached the station when the train left.
No sooner had she arrived than it started raining.

sections.title: Mixed Conditionals
sections.content:
Mixed conditionals में एक clause past unreal और दूसरा present result दिखाता है।

Common Structure:
If + Past Perfect, would + base verb

4-5 चरण समाधान विधि:
Step 1: देखें क्या past action का effect present में है।
Step 2: If clause में had + V3 लगाएं।
Step 3: Main clause में would + base verb रखें।
Step 4: Time reference अलग-अलग पहचानें।
Step 5: Logical connection जांचें।

Example:
If she had studied harder, she would be successful now.

sections.title: Complex Perfect Forms (have had / had had)
sections.content:
Have had = Present Perfect (experience/possession)।
Had had = Past Perfect (past of have)।

4-5 चरण समाधान विधि:
Step 1: देखें tense present है या past।
Step 2: Have/has had → present perfect sense।
Step 3: Had had → दो past events में पहले घटना।
Step 4: Context से possession या experience समझें।
Step 5: Double 'had' से भ्रमित न हों।

Example:
I have had this car for five years.
She had had dinner before I arrived.

sections.title: सामान्य गलतियाँ
sections.content:
1. Subjunctive में verb में s लगाना।
2. High time के बाद present tense लगाना।
3. Hardly के बाद सामान्य word order रखना।
4. Mixed conditional में दोनों clauses same time का बना देना।
5. Had had देखकर एक had हटा देना।

sections.title: त्वरित सारांश
sections.content:
Subjunctive = base verb।
High time = Simple Past form।
Inversion = auxiliary पहले।
Mixed conditional = अलग समय संदर्भ।
Have had और had had का अर्थ context से समझें।

tricks.title: Suggestion = Base Verb
tricks.explanation: Suggest, recommend, demand के बाद verb का base form रखें।
tricks.example: They suggested that he leave early.

tricks.title: High Time = Past Form
tricks.explanation: High time दिखे तो तुरंत verb को past में बदलें।
tricks.example: It is high time we took action.

tricks.title: Hardly Rule
tricks.explanation: Hardly से शुरुआत हो तो had + subject + V3 लिखें।
tricks.example: Hardly had he spoken when she interrupted.

tricks.title: No Sooner Pair
tricks.explanation: No sooner के साथ than आएगा।
tricks.example: No sooner had I arrived than it began to rain.

tricks.title: Mixed Time पहचान
tricks.explanation: If clause past और result present हो तो mixed conditional है।
tricks.example: If I had worked harder, I would be rich now.

tricks.title: Double Had मत डरें
tricks.explanation: Had had सही हो सकता है — एक auxiliary, एक main verb।
tricks.example: She had had lunch before the meeting started.

tricks.title: Were Alert
tricks.explanation: Formal unreal condition में were लगाएं।
tricks.example: If he were here, he would help.

tricks.title: Inversion Signal Words
tricks.explanation: Rarely, Never, Hardly से शुरुआत हो तो inversion सोचें।
tricks.example: Never have I seen such a view.
